title: Ordered Write Observation configuration wizard
summary: Designed a structured workflow for configuring an interconnect hardware feature with many interacting constraints.

dates.note: First inspected milestone: 2026-09-29. See facts for earlier/later feature stages; this is neither proof of first-ever work nor a formal role/leadership start or shipped release date.

facts.text: Created the Ordered Write Observation configuration wizard for newer NoC tooling.
Built an OWO wizard coordinating topology, interface prerequisites, protocols, resource planes, reserved credits, buffer capacities, stripe groups, memory maps and address alignment.
Separated component, orchestration facade, typed models, validation utilities and topology matrix, with plan/review/apply/restoration behavior and DRC explanations.
The introduction change included 12 Angular unit-spec files and five Playwright spec files, followed by recovery and feedback improvements.
Implemented sparse source/target topology checks, source-dependent credit-capacity calculations and memory-range alignment within the OWO plan/review/apply workflow.
Added project-bound opening checkpoints, content-fingerprint validation and stale-design detection to support safe wizard recovery.

The current opening-checkpoint restore includes later colleague changes to full Configuration Engine state/undo restoration; attribute wizard and checkpoint/fingerprint work to Michael without claiming every current recovery line.

notes: Ownership covers the wizard and orchestration, not authorship of the OWO hardware feature or every underlying Configuration Engine rule.
Spec-file counts describe a historical change, not coverage percentage or total current suite size.

2026-10-27 local Git/source research supplements prior evidence. Authorship supports attributable implementation; shared components and later colleague changes retain separate ownership. No employer tests were rerun.
